name: STEP 250 C
notes: NOT A SOLDERING PROFILE. Full power to 250 C, hold, then free cooling with the door SHUT -- the cooling curve is the measurement, so do not open it until the run ends. Asks for ramps the oven cannot meet on purpose: the controller saturates and the result is a step response. Extends the measured heating table, which currently stops at 235 C, and the cooling table, which stops at 240. Every lead-free profile is built from those two. Supervisor limits still apply: 260 C hard ceiling, 70 C enclosure, and ABORT works throughout. Run it empty. NOTE FOR NEXT TIME: the one-minute hold at 250 C is what stopped this extending the cooling table -- the controller was still heating at 333 s when the oven was down to 232 C, so the highest free-cooling sample was 224 C, below where the table already reached. To extend cooling, drop the hold and let it fall straight from the peak.
reference: characterisation step test, extending data/oven-characterisation.json above 240 C
